ruling.explanation:
Rider, the SGD 4.50 no-show charge stands, and the case produces a platform payment to the driver.

On the record, the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 19:58:47 on 5 September, and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02701, weight 1.0) independently places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that same second — the first qualifying in-geofence fix is 19:58:47, dwell start offset 0.0 s — and holds him stationary there for a continuous 429 seconds to 20:05:56. That is longer than the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). The trip was then terminated by the driver at 20:06:00 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are therefore met and the fee of SGD 4.50 (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, matching the fare_breakdown line of SGD 4.50) is legitimately chargeable.

Your own case is answered. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02701) shows the driver messaged 'hi im at the pickup point, where are you' at 19:59:12 and you replied only 'coming down now' at 20:01:07 — over two minutes after the driver arrived and with no entrance, block, tower or bay identified. Your rider track places your device about 884 m from the pin (mean 888 m, 0 qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius) throughout the waiting window. POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered) therefore does not apply: even if limb (a) were read in your favour, limb (c) fails affirmatively on admissible fixes, and so does not exonerate you. You were not 'only a few minutes late'.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at the arrival second the driver's speed is 0.0 kph and he is well inside 300 m of the pin, so the recorded waiting clock stands. POL-NS-06 does not apply: the effective dwell of 429 s exceeds the 180 s minimum (shortfall -249 s), so no refund arises. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02701-01, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) is not relied on for anything — the dwell is a single continuous run, so no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is needed, and its absence is not the evidence for any deciding fact. No integrity defect under POL-NS-08 was found: arrival timestamps match, the trace has no sampling gap, the chat count reconciles with the trip record, and the fare line equals the fee in force. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is engaged.

Under POL-NS-07 the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the fee in force, SGD 3.60, and the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 0, and 0 / 138 completed trips = 0.0). Because the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 figure as driver_compensation_sgd; that is the amount this ruling moves, and your SGD 4.50 charge is left in place. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04. No clause produces a referral on these facts.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
